# Coding 0.6.1

This patch fixes the macOS application bundle included in the first Coding
release.

## Fixed

- The complete application bundle is now ad-hoc signed, including its helpers,
  frameworks, and resources.
- Release builds verify the bundle with `codesign --verify --deep --strict`
  before uploading installers.

The `v0.6.0` bundle could be reported as damaged after download because only its
individual executables carried linker signatures. Replace it with `v0.6.1`.

## Downloads

DMG and ZIP builds are available for Apple Silicon (`arm64`) and Intel (`x64`)
Macs running macOS 12 or later.

These builds are not signed with an Apple Developer ID certificate and are not
notarized. macOS may still require approval under **System Settings > Privacy &
Security** after the first launch attempt. Warning-free installation requires
Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.
